+def flatten_experiments(matrix: Dict[str, Any], section: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    exps: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

+def estimate_minutes_per_epoch(exp: Dict[str, Any], cfg: CostInputs) -> float:
+    if not cfg.use_throughput_model:

+
+    batch_size = int(get_arg(exp, "batch-size", cfg.batch_size_default))
+    steps = math.ceil(cfg.train_samples / max(batch_size, 1))
+    minutes = (steps * cfg.seconds_per_step) / 60.0

+
+def summarize(estimates: List[Dict[str, Any]], cfg: CostInputs) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    total_hours = sum(item["total_hours"] for item in estimates)
+    total_cost = sum(item["cost_usd"] for item in estimates)
+    wall_clock_hours = total_hours / max(cfg.parallel_jobs, 1)
